description: Current price and core market stats (market cap, 24h volume, 24h change) across coin/currency batches. Accepts up to 500 raw IDs, processes the first 250 unique normalized IDs, and discloses skipped IDs separately. IDs are CoinGecko slugs (bitcoin, ethereum); resolve unknown tickers with coingecko_search_coins first. Partial unresolved IDs appear in missing; all unresolved IDs or resolved coins without numeric quotes produce distinct errors.

ids.description: CoinGecko slugs to price (e.g. ["bitcoin","ethereum"]). Accepts up to 500 raw entries; the first 250 unique normalized IDs are processed and the rest disclosed as skipped. Resolve tickers with coingecko_search_coins.

vs_currencies.description: Currency codes to price against (e.g. ["usd","eur","btc"]). Defaults to ["usd"].

name: coingecko_get_prices

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_price_data`: Some requested IDs resolved, but no numeric price was returned for the requested currencies. `all_missing`: No requested ID returned data — every slug was unknown or the upstream response was empty. `rate_limited`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 429 — the shared keyless pool is throttled, or the Demo-tier quota was hit. `upstream_invalid_params`: CoinGecko rejected the request parameters with HTTP 400. `upstream_validation_failed`: CoinGecko rejected request validation with HTTP 422. `upstream_unauthorized`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 401, including credential or historical-window restrictions. `upstream_forbidden`: CoinGecko denied access with HTTP 402 or 403. `upstream_not_found`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 404 on an endpoint without a domain-specific missing result. `upstream_invalid_request`: CoinGecko rejected the HTTP request with another permanent client status or redirect. `upstream_conflict`: CoinGecko returned HTTP 409, 423, or 424. `upstream_timeout`: A CoinGecko attempt timed out or returned HTTP 408, 425, or 504. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The coin-detail request, conditional currency lookup, and their retries exceeded one 50-second deadline. `upstream_deadline`: An externally supplied deadline expired during the CoinGecko exchange. `upstream_http_error`: CoinGecko returned permanent HTTP 501 Not Implemented. `upstream_unreachable`: CoinGecko was unreachable or returned a transient 5xx/HTML error after all retry attempts. `invalid_response`: CoinGecko returned a body that could not be parsed as JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

lastUpdatedAtUnixSec.description: Upstream last-updated time as a Unix timestamp in seconds (note: market-chart timestamps are milliseconds).

missing.description: Requested ids absent from the response (unknown slug or upstream silent miss). Re-resolve these with coingecko_search_coins. Empty when all ids resolved.

notice.description: Guidance when some requested ids returned no data — lists the missing ids and how to recover.

prices.description: One row per (id, currency) that returned a price. Data provided by CoinGecko.

items.description: Price and stats for one coin in one currency.

change24h.description: 24-hour price change as a percentage, when available.

currency.description: Currency code this row is denominated in.

marketCap.description: Market capitalization in the row currency, when available.

price.description: Current price in the row currency.

vol24h.description: 24-hour trading volume in the row currency, when available.

skippedIds.description: Normalized IDs beyond the 250 unique-ID processing cap; not upstream misses.

title: coingecko-mcp-server: get prices
